Supreme Court Reduces Rape Convict's Sentence, Citing Reformation Possibility

The Supreme Court has reduced the life sentence of a gang rape convict to 20 years. The court cited the convict's young age at the time of the offense, stating there was a possibility of reformation. This decision alters the original punishment awarded in the case.
